Bridge an inbound call leg to an ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent over a SIP trunk gateway. The gateway is provisioned manually from the ElevenLabs dashboard (see docs/admin/elevenlabs-freeswitch.md).
Variables: extension_number - dialed Odoo extension (regex anchor) agent_uid - ElevenLabs agent_id passed in the SIP user part and as X-Agent-Id header gateway_name - sofia gateway name (convention: 'elevenlabs')

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Agent-Id={{ agent_uid }}"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="bridge" data="{absolute_codec_string='PCMU,PCMA'}sofia/gateway/{{ gateway_name }}/{{ agent_uid }}"/> </condition> </extension>

<extension name="elevenlabs_agent_{{ extension_number }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ extension_number }}$"> <action application="set" data="hangup_after_bridge=true"/> <action application="set" data="continue_on_fail=true"/> <action application="set" data="sip_h_X-Agent-Id={{ agent_uid }}"/> <action application="answer"/> <action application="bridge" data="{absolute_codec_string='PCMU,PCMA'}sofia/gateway/{{ gateway_name }}/{{ agent_uid }}"/> </condition> </extension>
